purpose: Matched capacity-and-training-policy control for R05. Keep the same dual-stream architecture, complete 16k schedule, and Q+D treatment probabilities as R05, but replace DSM with a fixed one-channel mean of the identically transformed Optical RGB crop. This separates DSM-specific information from dual-stream capacity and Q+D regularization.

augmentation.corruption_order: normalized Optical -> matched crop/resize/flip -> fixed Optical-gray second stream -> dropout decision -> conditional quality corruption -> network
augmentation.second_stream_probability_key_note: Legacy dsm_* probability keys are retained only to match the R05 policy numerically; in C-OO-QD they apply to the Optical-gray second stream, not DSM.

second_stream.treatment_label_note: second_stream_* output labels correspond to the R05 DSM-branch treatment positions, but the actual content is Optical grayscale
